'''Xebonica''' was a drug used for chemical [[Torture/Legends|torture]]. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], xebonica was one of many torture drugs used by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] to tear information from the reluctant.<ref name="J10">{{JournalCite|10|Desperate Measures}}</ref>
